SUM8.fpga_role: multi-frame aggregation for corrected power, corrected cross, raw power, and quality counts

SUM8_V8L1.payload_shape: sum8 aggregate page plus 0x17c sequence and agg_control bit2 auto-roll

SUM8_V8L2.fpga_role: keep auto-roll running after each aggregate target window instead of stalling after the first latched page
SUM8_V8L2.nx_role: configure once, monitor AGG_SEQUENCE, read latest aggregate page, and fall back to V8L1/V8 if validation fails
SUM8_V8L2.payload_shape: V8L1-compatible summary registers with V8L2 build IDs and continuous auto-roll sequence
